papers.title: Recompute, Dispatch, or Check? A Game-Tick Study of Stateless and Event-Driven State
papers.author: Martin Petkovski
papers.abstract: A formal and empirical C11 comparison of full stateless Tick recomputation, stateful event dispatch outside Tick, and version-checked selective recomputation inside Tick, including speed, memory, function-stack complexity, stale-cache faults, and a measured arithmetic threshold for a 1 ms p99 frame-work proxy.

papers.title: Analysis and Application of State Machines in the Design of Branching Systems, with Special Emphasis on Video Games
papers.author: Martin Petkovski
papers.abstract: This thesis analyzes state-machine implementations for branching systems, proposes author-oriented methods and tools for nonlinear narratives, and demonstrates the approach through a branching-dialogue video game integrated with Unreal Engine 5.
